infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Dawuro uses the camera to capture photo and video evidence of incidents.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Dawuro records audio with incident videos so the footage carries its original context.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Dawuro needs your precise location to stamp incident reports with accurate GPS coordinates. The camera only unlocks once an accurate fix is acquired.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Dawuro can save a copy of the footage you capture to your photo library.
